name: Pink Haze 2
source:
Main character has been working in a semen clinic for half a year already. Friend's pharmacist deliberately wants his semen. One day another pharmacist comes over and evaluates his sperm as "not that interesting". What's the fate of protagonist and his semen?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角已经在精液诊所工作了半年了。朋友的药剂师故意想要他的精液。有一天，另一位药剂师过来评价他的精子“没那么有趣”。主角和他的精液的命运如何？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
